page_title: Pushing the limits of UAV performance | Betaflight

summary.name: Betaflight
summary.one_liner: Betaflight is free, open-source flight control firmware for drones, covering racing, freestyle, cinematic, long-range, micro and wing builds.
use_cases: Configuring an FPV racing or freestyle drone
Setting up flight controller firmware for a custom build
Displaying flight telemetry on an FPV video feed
Tuning drone flight dynamics and responsiveness
Finding community help for drone builds
summary.what_it_does: Betaflight is flight control firmware that runs on drone flight controllers from many manufacturers and is described as suitable for racing, freestyle, cinematic, long-range, micro and wing drones. It includes an On Screen Display (OSD) configurable by drag-and-drop to show metrics such as battery, speed, altitude and home direction over the FPV video. It provides safety features including alerts and arming blocks for improper setup, disarm mechanisms, and a failsafe mechanism. The page also mentions a Betaflight App being prepared for iOS (public beta on TestFlight) and an App that is adopting TypeScript. The source code is on GitHub and accepts contributions.
notable: Open source flight control firmware for many drone types
Drag-and-drop on-screen display for FPV video
Built-in arming blocks, disarm and failsafe safety features
Betaflight Supported hardware marking and partner program
caveats: Support for each board depends on its manufacturer; only reviewed boards with manufacturer commitment are marked Betaflight Supported
Donations are requested to cover costs; developers work unpaid
